device.name: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

physics_flops.source: state-adrend_1024 (final ADR: full gravity, random Gaussian actions std 1, scale 0.1 rad relative joint targets)

notes: derived from measured nq/nv/obs terms; assumed design: fp32, table as static geometry (stock MJWarp model has it as a free body: nq 37/nv 35)

observation histories (stock: 1595 floats/env = 6380 B) are re-derived from the last 4 raw frames: hand-tip poses by FK from joint_pos, object quat / point cloud from object_pose and a shared per-object-type 64-point table (16 types x 768 B), noise from a counter-based RNG

startup DR values (friction, mass/inertia, gains, joint friction, armature) and per-env gravity kept per env; derived model quantities (invweight0, acc0, subtree mass) recomputed or cached in the fixed per-type tables
reset bank (16 groups x 1024 states x 85 floats = 5.57 MB) and success monitor are global/fixed, not per env

stock_rsl_rl_state_task.description: RSL-RL 5.5.1 layout, state task (policy+proprio+perception histories fp32)

stock_rsl_rl_rgb64(uint8).description: RSL-RL layout, camera task: all 4 obs groups incl. uint8 3x64x64

stock_rsl_rl_depth64(fp32).description: RSL-RL layout, camera task: all 4 obs groups incl. fp32 1x64x64 depth

lean_state_only.description: raw frame fp32 + lean PPO fields (no image)

lean_(i)_uint8_rgb64.description: uint8 RGB 64x64 + raw state frame fp32

lean_(ii)_latent64_fp32.description: 64 keypoint features fp32 (= stock spatial-softmax width)

lean_(iv)_state_replay_rerender.description: store qpos (+object id) per step, re-render images inside each PPO epoch
